verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only inbound warehouse syncing (Snowflake/BigQuery/etc. into Mixpanel) and pull-based export APIs (Raw Event Export, Query API, CSV), none of which describe pushing/streaming events out to CRM systems, ad platforms, or webhooks. The partner integrations directory lists third-party platforms (mParticle, Census, Vendo) but their descriptions frame them as bringing data INTO Mixpanel, not Mixpanel streaming events out to them.
